sourceText: Start implementing the framework-compliant Story that safely parallelizes the complete test suite and reduces total runtime below five minutes.
normalizedOutcome: The canonical full root test suite executes safely in parallel and reports every required member passing in less than five minutes on three reproducible clean-clone runs.
acceptanceClaim: Three consecutive same-material clean-clone npm test runs each complete below 300000 ms with complete membership, terminal first failures, isolated resources, and unchanged deterministic assertion and mutation coverage.
